During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] established a support '''base''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seven Flames]]. The base housed several [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] agents and was where the defecting [[Governor/Legends|Imperial Governor]] [[Darryn Edalm]] was questioned before being sent to [[Shimmer]].
